sources.title: PCBWay multi-layer laminated structures (298 standard stackups, not machine-readable)

capabilities.layer_counts_note: standard 1-14 layers; up to 16 normal multilayer, 18-24 non-standard review, above 24 not made
capabilities.impedance_note: impedance control tolerance +/-10 %, 50 ohm and below +/-5 ohm (capabilities page); no layer-count restriction stated
capabilities.materials_note: FR-4, CEM-3, LianMao IT158/IT180A; high-Tg and halogen-free as advanced PCB

rf.note: HF page: RO4003C, RO4350B, RO3003, RO3010, RT5880; RO4450F as the prepreg of pure RO4000 multilayers

capabilities.hybrid_note: Rogers4 series + FR-4 mixed (prepreg ShengYi and ROGERS4403 series); PTFE+FR4; pure RO4000 multilayer with 4450F prepreg
capabilities.ptfe_note: pure PTFE multilayer cannot be made (lamination temperature; Rogers copper foil cannot be laminated directly)
